filter_instruction: Keep a message if it could be a company raising money, or a message about a deal the fund is already working on: a cold email from a founder, a forward of a pitch or deck, an introduction from a mutual contact, an investor update, a data room invite, or a reply that continues a fundraising conversation. Drop it only when it is plainly none of those: a newsletter, an automated notification, a receipt or invoice, a calendar accept or decline, spam or a promo blast, someone selling a product or service TO the fund (agencies, tools, recruiters pitching candidates, event sponsors), or mail the fund sent itself. When it is genuinely unclear, keep it: a deal wrongly dropped is invisible, while a deal wrongly kept is dismissed in one click from the inbox.
name: gmail-intake
